plan.title: Scholarship Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Overview of scholarship applicants

panels.title: Total applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Approved applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Approved'

panels.title: Rejected applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Rejected'

panels.title: Applicants by status
panels.sql: SELECT Status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applicants by marks
panels.sql: SELECT Marks %, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applicants by income
panels.sql: SELECT Family Income, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 talukas by applicants
panels.sql: SELECT Taluka, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 schemes by applicants
panels.sql: SELECT Name of scheme, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
